text: This report reviews and recommends approval of the application to amend the Zoning By-law to permit an office use to occupy the entire house-form building at 124 Bedford Road.

City Council on June 14 and 15, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend Zoning By-law 569-2013 for the lands at 124 Bedford Road substantially in accordance with the draft Zoning By-law Amendment attached as Attachment 4 to the report (May 5, 2023) from the Acting Director, Community Planning, Toronto and East York District. 2. City Council authorize the City Solicitor to make such stylistic and technical changes to the draft Zoning By-law Amendment as may be required.
